_comment: Where the tree starts, and — separately — whose tree it is. `roots` is a list for the forest case; the first is where the explorer opens, and reachability, the census and frontier depth all measure from all of them. Objective 3 builds a FOREST of Bundervoet families, so a root here need not connect to Renee and Leon — bundervoet_egidius is the documented head of the Gent family and is deliberately unlinked to them. `named` answers the other question: who the page says the tree is OF. It is the two children of objective 1 and it does not grow, whereas `roots` gains an entry every time objective 3 documents another disconnected head. Building the title from `roots` put a Gent patriarch in it. Confidence codes are data; their human labels are in site/.
